excerpt: Stop Reactive Hiring: How to Build a Talent Pipeline Before the Vacancy Hits Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. The Vacancy That Costs the Most Is the One You Didn’t See Coming Here is how reactive hiring typically plays out. A key employee resigns — or is promoted, or burns out, or is let go — and suddenly there is an urgent gap. The hiring manager needs someone yesterday. A job posting goes up in a hurry, often with requirements pulled from the last time the role was posted.
author: Anuj Sengar
